translator.evidence:
Original AI-assisted zu catalog covers all 1315 English source messages in 12 family slices. Technical identifiers, standard notation, and formatting were retained where appropriate; no upstream translated catalog is claimed. Updated 2026-09-28 with 69 original messages for change review, agent questions, permission rules, connectors, background runs, research progress and budgets. Placeholders and locale-specific plural forms are preserved; no upstream translated text was copied.

2026-09-29 incremental pollRefresh review: added one original action label to this locale catalog, using existing refresh/update wording as context. The contribution remains AI-assisted and makes no human or native-speaker translator claim.

reviewer.evidence:
AI-assisted independent semantic review read all 1,315 messages in all 12 slices. Corrected a reversed tool-call cap message, finite-number meaning, enabled-tool wording, artifact grammar, bubble radius, token input/output labels, operator/entity terminology, legend/citation terminology, sparse/dense score labels, and failed-evaluation wording. Checked Zulu register, isiZulu script, placeholders, plural forms, and English-identical entries. This review is not native-speaker certification. Updated 2026-09-28: an independent AI-assisted review checked all 69 added messages for meaning, UI register, terminology and placeholders, and corrected the catalog before this snapshot. The research-source count was checked against the pinned CLDR categories, including locale-specific decimal and non-singular forms. The complete 1,384-key snapshot was checked for key coverage, value kinds, placeholders and exact-English message paths; only individually justified new cognates, loanwords and technical names were retained. This increment does not claim a new linguistic review of all older messages, human review or native-speaker certification.

2026-09-29 incremental pollRefresh review: an AI-assisted bounded review checked this new action label for meaning, UI action wording and absence of placeholders or exact-English copy. This review covers only this addition, not prior catalog entries; no human or native-speaker certification is claimed.
